In this episode Anna Maria and Brian Clement discuss Brian's book Quantum Human, the pioneering work of Dr. Valerie Hunt, and how electromagnetic frequency and energy medicine underlie health, disease reversal, and longevity. They also introduce Quantum Cuisine and explain why raw, living foods and advanced noninvasive therapies are central to Hippocrates Wellness programs.

Listeners learn about cutting-edge practices available at the Hippocrates Wellness Institute in West Palm Beach, practical steps to boost cellular vibration and resilience, and how these science-based approaches have helped reverse chronic disease over seven decades.
